messages:
Jo: quick thought — can we add a tiny "effective permission" simulator in the route editor? show which roles + scopes would actually allow a request and surface any quota delta.
Matt: ooh yeah. basically a live 'what-if' overlay? :eyes:
Sanjay: +1. customers always ask "who can call this route" and then freak out about quota surprises. a preview that includes quota consumption feels helpful.
Aly: UX nit: keep it non-modal. small breadcrumb / pill next to the route name with a hover panel. show: (1) effective perms, (2) top 2 roles that grant access, (3) quota hit estimate.
Jo: prototype idea — when you type a scope expression in the role editor we can evaluate it against the route's policy and show a compact table. example output: `Route: /v1/generate — allowed by: team-gen, svc-embed; quota change: +1.2 tokens/sec estimate`
Matt: technical: we need an API that returns effective principals and estimated QPS/tokens for a sample call. something like: `POST /internal/preview/route` body `{ "route_id": "r-123", "sample_request": {...}, "effects": ["perm","quota"] }` response would list principals + delta.
Sanjay: runtime note — keep it cached per route+role-set; don't run whole policy engine on every keystroke. maybe run in debounce and show stale indicator. ConsoleBot: Deploy check passed for `preview-api-v1` (canary) :white_check_mark:
Aly: telemetry: we should emit events when people open the preview and when they roll out a role change after viewing. fields: `preview.open`, `preview.apply_after_view`, `preview_sample_type` (token/QPS). this helps correlate previews to fewer support tickets.
Jo: rollout flow: default preview shows "best guess" quota delta — prefix with ~ and link to detailed estimator. allow toggling "use canary estimator" vs "prod estimator".
Matt: API caution: don't leak other tenant principals. preview must only return aggregated/labelled results like `team-gen` not user lists.
Sanjay: agree. and hide any service account ids, show role display names + scope match snippet. e.g. `role: team-gen — matches scope: routes:generate[*]`
Aly: quick copy for tooltip: "Preview shows which roles would permit this route and an estimate of quota impact for a representative request. Not a guarantee — final enforcement happens at runtime."
Jo: next steps: Matt to sketch API proto, Aly to wire a small hover panel in the route editor (no modal), Sanjay to draft caching/consistency constraints, I'll draft telemetry schema. target spike PR end of week?
Matt: yep will have an API proto by Thursday.
Sanjay: caching doc + edge cases by Friday EOD; will include offline evaluation for large tenants.
Aly: I'll drop a quick figma and ping @design for microcopy.
Jo: great — thanks. tiny follow-up: can we include a "simulate as" selector (role or service account) so PMs can validate behaviour for edge roles?
Matt: doable — just need to pass an optional `simulate_as` in the preview request.
ConsoleBot: Reminder: internal API preview endpoints are behind feature flag `rbac_preview` — enable per-org for testing.
Jo: perfect. :thumbsup:
